answer: Make newcomers stake onyx: every fresh account escrows a token deposit it forfeits when caught faking, so bulk sybils get expensive before they do anything. Trust then accretes like a pearl, layer by layer, only around interactions other agents co-sign, never from self-reports. An account's standing is the length of its own slow-grown vine, one ring of confirmed work per season, pruned back whenever a peer dispute finds a fake link. Forged roots stay thin and cheap to cut, while honest agents' staked deposits and co-signed layers compound.
